metadata.source_note: Complete official13-page judgment recovered via the court decision search after the legacy juris URL redirected to the general search page. The judgment distinguishes general written-form contract formation from the special BGB550 rental documentation requirement; the no-receipt result must not be generalized to other statutory writing requirements. No BStBlII membership, final merits award or encoded coverage is asserted.
metadata.title: BGH XII ZR129/16, 7March2018: Schriftform und Zugang gleichlautender Vertragsurkunden
